comments.value: I'm a fan of the opaque crystal as the default option, even if they are large. So I guess a toggle is whatever
Those opaque diamonds are freaking gross
I agree, solid diamonds greatly clutter and reduce visibility in clubs, the old way was much preferred- or give a transparency slider or toggle. I also hoped it was a bug during the beta.

One possible solution would be to remove the mesh from the center of the crystal, even if it is opaque, leaving only the head and sides of the crystal. This would not affect performance, would minimize obstruction to visibility, and would also maintain the player's presence.
Unfortunately the diamonds are much bigger than most avatars, so yeah it's very annoying.

I absolutely agree that there needs to be more options for the diamond's visibility. Please make opaque just one of several options, for example "transparent" (the former default) and "do not show". That way everyone can decide for themselves what performs best on their individual hardware.

And how about giving diamonds a property to not the rendered when taking pictures, just like other shader systems can do?
aaaaaaaaaandddd they reverted them to fully transparent. This should just be a client option!

The previous change has been reverted and the diamonds are now back to being transparent/translucent 

But this Feature request still stands as we want more options regarding the Culling Diamonds.

A lot of people in the comments provided great solutions! 

I hope the VRChat team can work with this information!

前回の変更が元に戻され、ダイヤモンドは再び透明または半透明に戻りました。しかし、この機能リクエストは依然として有効です。カリングダイヤモンドに関して、より多くのオプションを求めています。コメント欄では多くの人が素晴らしい解決策を提供してくれました！VRChatチームがこの情報を活用してくれることを願っています！
I actually liked that the diamonds were opaque for a few days, made it easier to see them from a distance and/or in darker clubs. Agreed a toggle would be great, if not a radial adjustment.
A little disappointed that PC reverted fully back to transparent diamonds

details:
Since the new patch avatars which are hidden now show up as solid diamonds instead of translucent ones.

This is extremely disruptive as they now block your sight (Screenshot attached, a live stage performance by Phantom in VRC)

From the reaction that I got from my ticket it seems that this was an intentional change to increase performance! 

Please make a toggle so that they can be allowed translucent again.

It is essential for a lot of live performance in bands!

新しいパッチ以降、非表示のアバターが半透明のものではなく、不透明なダイヤモンドとして表示されるようになりました。これが非常に邪魔で、視界を遮ってしまいます（添付のスクリーンショットは、VRCでのPhantomによるライブステージパフォーマンスです）。

サポートチケットからの反応を見る限り、これはパフォーマンス向上のために意図的に行われた変更のようです！ ぜひ、再び半透明にできるようにトグルを追加してください。バンドによる多くのライブパフォーマンスにはこれが不可欠です！
title: Allow hidden avatars diamonds to be translucent instead of solid (toggle)
